info.title: Welfare Policy Search and Eligibility API
info.description: Search Korean welfare policies and perform conservative second-stage eligibility screening using only user-provided facts.

post.summary: Search policies or run second-stage eligibility screening
post.description: Use action=search for the first policy search. For broad requests use interest=전체. Use action=diagnose after the first search or when the user provides follow-up income, housing, asset, household, welfare-status, crisis, medical or credit information. Never infer missing personal facts. Diagnosis is a conservative screening result, not a final legal eligibility decision.

action.description: search = first-stage policy search, diagnose = second-stage eligibility screening

employmentStatus.description: Example: 미취업, 재직중, 단시간근로, 프리랜서, 일용근로, 자영업

keyword.description: Use only concepts explicitly stated by the user. Never invent special-target status.

annualIncome.description: Annual personal income in 10,000 KRW units when explicitly provided.

monthlyIncome.description: Current personal monthly income in KRW. Use 0 only when the user explicitly says no income.

livingWithParents.description: true only when the user explicitly says they live with parents.

noHome.description: true means the user explicitly states they do NOT own a home; false means they own a home.

savings.description: Approximate savings and financial assets in KRW.

assetsTotal.description: Approximate total assets in KRW when known.

householdMonthlyIncome.description: Approximate monthly income of the household used for screening, in KRW.

priorityWelfareStatus.description: Explicit statuses only, e.g. 기초생활수급, 차상위, 한부모, 근로장려금 자격, or 해당 없음.

crisisReason.description: Explicit emergency reason such as recent job loss, closure, serious illness, or '없음'.

medicalExpenseNeed.description: true only if the user states that a serious medical-expense burden actually exists.

creditNeed.description: Whether the user wants policy-loan options considered.

creditStatus.description: Only explicit information such as 저신용, 신용평점 하위권, 근로장려금 자격, or 모름.

200.description: Successful policy search or eligibility screening response
